kind: A look back at a launch with no action items: finished work, numbers, a dream feature, one decision to keep doing something

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Hey, thanks for hopping on. There's no agenda today. I just wanted to look back at the 1.3 launch while it's still fresh.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Honestly, it went well. The store page looked great, and the reviews keep mentioning the art, which makes me very happy.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: On my side, the servers were boring, which is exactly what you want. The peak was about four thousand players at once, and we never went above forty percent CPU.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: That's great. Last launch we were scrambling all weekend.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Remember the font bug, where the Japanese text was cut off? That's fixed, by the way. It went out in the last patch.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: And I moved all the server docs into the wiki last week, so that's done too.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Nice. I was going to ask about that.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: Support tickets were down as well. About thirty a day, instead of a hundred after the last launch.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: The new help page probably did that.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Probably. Marta said the same thing.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Something I've been thinking about: some day it would be cool to have a level editor, so players could make their own levels. Not as a plan, just a dream.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: It would be amazing, and also a year of work.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Yes. Let's keep dreaming about it, but it's not on any roadmap.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: One more thing I noticed. Our crash rate went down from two percent to half a percent after the engine upgrade. So the upgrade paid off.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: That's a big drop.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: It is. I think we should keep shipping every two weeks, the way we did this time. It worked.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: Agreed, two weeks felt right.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Yes, let's keep it.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: Unrelated, but the new coffee machine in the office is great.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Finally, yes.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: OK, that's all I had. No action items, I just wanted to say thanks. Good work, both of you.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Thanks, Julio.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: Thanks. See you tomorrow.

notTasks.text: A level editor (a dream, not on any roadmap)
Moving the server docs to the wiki (already done)

truth.notes: There are no tasks in this call. Any proposed task is invented.
